answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> False Sects Question ID: 43680 Country: Pakistan Title: Was Abual Ala Maududi a right scholar or not? Question: Was Abual Ala Maududi a right scholar or not? Give me detail about him. Answer ID: 43680 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 329/329/M=1434) Abul Ala Maududi was not formally an Alim hence there is no question of right or wrong. He admits that he does not enjoy the honour of being among the folk of Ulama, he is a middle man.......(Tarjuman Al-Quran 1355 Hijrah). “The modus operandi and views of Maududi is quite different from that of Salf Salihin. He has adopted such a way for his Jamah and for his new maslak which differs quietly from the holy Quran, Hadith and belief of Ahl sunnah al Jamah”. (Jamat-e-Islami Ka Dini Rukh, 31) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
